_meta.tool: Playwright 1.64.1 + Chromium (headless), isolated install outside the project
_meta.note: Read-only against production (GET + client-side interaction only; no form submissions, no writes). These are the results of the successful measured run on 2026-10-20. A later re-run attempt hit a 30s navigation-wait TIMEOUT on the in-text-link click step — a test-harness flake (the link itself was already measured clicking through to /cookies in the run below), not a site defect. Re-running requires reinstalling the isolated Playwright/Chromium (the temp dir is periodically swept).

results.name: 1 RTL layout geometry (AR /privacy)
results.evidence: htmlDir=rtl summaryDir=rtl summaryTextAlign=start (CSS 'start' resolves to right under rtl); layout mirrors correctly

results.name: 2 Cookie modal focus trap (both boundaries)
results.evidence: focusables=5; Tab@last -> wraps inside; Shift+Tab@first -> wraps inside (focus never leaves the modal)

results.name: 2 Overlay recovery (cookie <-> Ask USAM)
results.evidence: both close on Escape; body.overflow returns to 'visible' after each; stuckBackdrop=false; footer nav click works after closing

results.name: 3 clicks reach correct destinations + anchor below sticky header
results.evidence: footer->/privacy (h1 'Privacy Policy.'); ToC anchor headingTop=96 >= stickyHeaderBottom=82 (visible below header); in-text link->/cookies url=true; nav->/for-enterprises (h1 'Find people, capability, and p...')

results.name: 4 @mobile 375px overflow + modal fit
results.evidence: scrollWidth=375 innerWidth=375 overflow=false; cookie modal fits within viewport

results.name: 4 200% zoom
results.evidence: CSS zoom:2 -> scrollWidth=640 innerWidth=640, no horizontal overflow. NATIVE 200% BROWSER ZOOM REMAINS UNVERIFIED (not equivalent to CSS zoom).

results.name: 5 contrast ratios (light theme)
results.evidence: min 7.66:1. legal body 7.66; summary 7.66; meta 14.28; h1 15.17; in-text link 7.66; form label 16.16; primary button 14.45; cookie panel text 8.16. All >= WCAG AA 4.5:1.

results.name: 5 contrast ratios (dark theme)
results.evidence: min 8.17:1. legal body 11.05; summary 11.05; meta 12.13; h1 15.77; in-text link 11.05; form label 13.35; primary button 8.17; cookie panel text 9.35. All >= WCAG AA 4.5:1.

results.name: 6 print/PDF export
results.status: PASS (export measured; page-break aesthetics NOT inspected)
results.evidence: Exported valid %PDF- (47325 bytes); 9 sections rendered; print media: site-header/footer/legal-toc display:none, legal-sections + legal-meta visible. NOTE: the exported pages were NOT visually rendered/inspected, so 'no clipping / sensible page breaks' is NOT claimed — only that chrome is hidden and content+meta are present in print media.
